c0032: Card fees on total sales. Hosts and planners mostly pay by card, with some ACH or check from companies, which lowers the cost. The example (3%) is a blended rate: a percentage plus a per-transaction fee, which weighs more on small deposits. Check your processor's statement and enter your effective rate (Kit estimate).
c0364: Hours of work that one event needs: shopping, packing, loading, transport, setup, service, breakdown and cleanup. Serving is only part of it. Hours × people × events per year sets the event staff cost.
c0466: A revenue line that pays for no mixers, garnishes or ice shows a margin that does not exist.
c0460: A miscellaneous line typed in among the fixed costs
c0461: A percentage of sales, treated as a variable cost; tow vehicle and trailer fuel has its own fixed line
